sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the unconditional speed operand and single-valued selector, but add sh:class nltl:tableLookupCase to the nltl:hasTableLookupCase property constraint on gs:TRF083Shape. The nested sh:node validates any linked node but does not enforce that the required ship-to-case relationship has the canonical tableLookupCase range.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Require propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard with its quantity shape for every targeted ship, not only in the rotationalSpeedKnown=false branch, because it is a declared operand. Also enforce rotationalSpeedKnown as a single-valued selector (sh:maxCount 1) so simultaneous true and false values cannot select the known branch and bypass the Table 6-9 case, reference, and evidence requirements.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unapproved external/generated IRI(s): http://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/RotationalVelocity
Semantic validator feedback: Remove the unapproved external qk:RotationalVelocity constraint; it causes deterministic vocabulary failure and no approved quantity-kind IRI is supplied. Add sh:class nltl:tableLookupCase to the nltl:hasTableLookupCase property so the required relationship range is enforced, while retaining the already-required unconditional speed operand and single-valued rotationalSpeedKnown selector.

Preserve the unconditional speed operand and single-valued selector, but add sh:class nltl:tableLookupCase to the nltl:hasTableLookupCase property constraint on gs:TRF083Shape. The nested sh:node validates any linked node but does not enforce that the required ship-to-case relationship has the canonical tableLookupCase range.
